annotations.title: Create a TikTok Smart+ ad (forced paused)

description: Add the creative to a Smart+ ad group. Smart+ combines the materials you give it rather than running one fixed cut, so this is where the videos and copy go. Created PAUSED. If TikTok accepts the request but returns no ad id, the reply says nothing is confirmed to exist rather than claiming success — check Ads Manager before retrying, or a second call can create a twin.

adConfiguration.description: TikTok ad_configuration for Spark or catalog ads (identity_type, identity_id, product_set_id, …)

adTexts.description: up to 5 ad texts; required unless every creative is a tiktok_item_id Spark post

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

callToActions.description: up to 3 TikTok call-to-action enums, e.g. LEARN_MORE, SHOP_NOW

creatives.description: up to 50 TikTok creative_info objects: {ad_format: "SINGLE_VIDEO" | "CAROUSEL_ADS", video_info: {video_id}, image_info: [{web_uri}], tiktok_item_id, identity_type, identity_id}. Ids come from upload_tiktok_ads_creative and list_tiktok_ads_identities

disclaimerLinks.description: OR up to 3 clickable disclaimers; their texts may total 40 characters

disclaimerText.description: a text disclaimer shown on the ad, up to 90 characters

interactiveAddOnCardId.description: ONE interactive add-on card id: a Display, Hotel, Flight or Destination Card, or a Countdown or Gift Code Sticker

name.description: ad name; "" lets TikTok name it after the ad id

playableUrls.description: up to 5 playableUrl values from upload_tiktok_ads_playable. App Promotion ads with a SINGLE_VIDEO creative only; TikTok allowlists Playable Ads per advertiser

name: create_tiktok_smart_ad
